g.text: Claims about stepwise selection: reading critically
According to Diekhoff (1992), the stepwise procedure has an advantage over
the other procedures because it is more economical, and only the
significant predictor variable is entered into the regression.
Another advantage is that multi-collinearity problems, which exist as a
result of strong correlations between variables, can be prevented in this
Such correlations are meaningless and result in inaccurate analysis
Such problems can be avoided through stepwise multiple regression as
problematic variables will not be included in the regression. [Original
